envelope.controlled_versus_robustness: every gating criterion is a controlled-source criterion; the sealed holdout contains no robustness cell, so no robustness result is produced, claimed, or gated

failure_logic.narrower_envelope_rule: a narrower envelope proposed after a failure requires new preregistered criteria and a new, previously unseen holdout; the original failed evidence is retained
failure_logic.on_failure: any failed readiness criterion keeps S4.8 and S4 failed for the claimed envelope; the failed evidence is archived and remains useful for diagnosis
prohibited_after_freeze: selecting or changing any threshold from held-out results
removing, replacing, or reweighting a scenario or take
shrinking a denominator to the successful count
reclassifying a failed criterion as not_evaluable
narrowing the envelope to convert a failure into a pass
failure_logic.readiness_pass_rule: S4.8 passes for the claimed envelope only when every readiness criterion passes
failure_logic.stretch_rule: stretch criteria are computed and reported but never change the gate

excluded_historical_holdout.reason: the original six-cell S4.4 holdout draws on S4.3 pilot outcomes that were already analyzed, so it is not blind and carries no gating power in S4.8

missing_and_unsupported_treatment.rationale: a missing or malformed result must never read as a pass; every absence is a failure or an explicit not_evaluable declaration

conditions: angle families other than the two frozen sweeps
moving sources or a moving array
not_evaluable.declaration: these quantities have a zero holdout denominator; S4.8 reports them as not_evaluable and may not compute, threshold, or claim them for this envelope
not_evaluable.future_requirement: any robustness or wider-envelope claim requires a new, previously unseen holdout under a new preregistration; it may never be obtained by reinterpreting this holdout

phase_boundary.allowed_claim: preregistered, decision-relevant functional acceptance criteria for the exact sealed holdout, frozen before any held-out observation was opened

sim_vs_real.adjusted_simulation_definition: the S4.6 profile application in mode apply over the identical geometric condition; the unadjusted path is the same run in mode off
sim_vs_real.classification_rule: compute the adjusted minus unadjusted change in the metric, signed so that a negative change is better; classify as preserves when the absolute change is at or below the frozen preserve band, improves when the change is better than the band, and worsens when it is worse than the band
sim_vs_real.harness_status: no sim-versus-real comparison harness exists in the repository at freeze time; S4.8 builds it against these frozen criteria
sim_vs_real.reporting_requirement: every condition, sample, repetition, and failure is reported for all three paths with median, p95, and worst; no scenario may be removed

statistics.absolute_median_difference: absolute value of the median difference
statistics.max_group_circular_range: the maximum circular range taken over every declared group, using the frozen S4.3 largest-gap convention on bearings modulo 360
statistics.max_group_range: the maximum plain range taken over every declared group
statistics.median: arithmetic median of the finite sample values; the mean of the two central values for an even sample count
statistics.median_difference: median of the first named series minus the median of the second
statistics.p95_nearest_rank: deterministic nearest rank: the value at index max(1, ceil(0.95 * n)) of the ascending finite sample, one-indexed, matching the frozen S4.3 convention
statistics.range: maximum minus minimum of the finite sample values
statistics.rate: numerator divided by denominator; the denominator must equal the frozen expected count when one is declared
statistics.small_sample_labeling: any statistic computed from fewer than eight samples is labeled small_sample in the report; the threshold comparison is unchanged
statistics.worsened_gating_metric_count: the number of gating metrics whose adjusted-versus-unadjusted comparison classifies as worsens under the frozen preserve bands
statistics.worst: maximum of the finite sample values

strata.note: these bearings fall exactly on the boundaries of the eight 45 deg sectors, so a sub-degree bearing error flips the sector by construction; sector accuracy is therefore not a meaningful measurement here and is not gated on this stratum
these bearings sit at sector centers with a full 22.5 deg margin, which is the only geometry in the sealed holdout where sector accuracy is a meaningful decision
